articles.title: Big Stars Left Out: England's World Cup Squad Surprises!
articles.summary: Phil Foden, Cole Palmer, and Trent Alexander-Arnold are not on England's World Cup team! Coach Thomas Tuchel picked 26 players, but left out these famous names. Harry Maguire said he was 'shocked and gutted.'

articles.title: A Stranger's Kind Words Changed Her Life After Cancer
articles.summary: Pat Gentile was losing her hair from chemotherapy and felt scared to go out without a wig. Then a stranger in a store told her she looked 'fabulous.' That one compliment gave her the courage to face the world.

articles.title: Tulsi Gabbard Steps Down as Trump's Spy Chief
articles.summary: Tulsi Gabbard resigned as President Trump's director of national intelligence. She said her husband has a rare bone cancer and she needs to take care of him. She is the fourth top official to leave during Trump's second term.
